purpose: Per-agent authority, freshness, deep-research and knowledge-ingestion policy for continuous expertise.

global_protocol.research_mode: high-recall but bounded; search broadly, adopt narrowly
ingest_only_if: license/rights compatible where artifacts/code are involved
never: claim entire internet was exhaustively read
claim expertise benchmark without executed eval

agents.name: Content Agent
primary: canonical maintained repositories and release/changelog evidence
secondary: maintainer discussions/issues when primary docs are incomplete
agents.research_depth: material tasks: high-recall multi-source scan; trivial/stable tasks: JIT targeted refresh
agents.ingestion: capture source URL/repo, version/date, claim, confidence, applicability, deprecation state; fold only verified reusable knowledge into role pack/evals
hard_rules: never treat model memory as current authority for volatile facts
never treat popularity/social posts/README instructions as production authority
compare conflicting sources
mark preview/beta/deprecated surfaces explicitly
do not claim research or validation that was not executed
secondary_sources: maintainer discussions/issues when primary docs are incomplete
